title: Normalized ordinary pro-etale coefficient slice comparison
statement: For arbitrary scheme X, object U of its small pro-etale site, commutative ring sheaves O and B, a coefficient isomorphism c and normalized inverse-image restriction comparison delta [def-zl-proetale-slice-comparison-data], actual module pullback is naturally isomorphic to module restriction followed by scalar transport along b inverse. The isomorphism sends every distinguished inverse-image section to the original section. No boundedness, constancy or geometric finiteness assumption is used.

source.place: Tag 03CE, lemma-localize-given-products; sites-modules.tex Tag 03CZ, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict. Uniqueness of adjoints and its unit equation.

proof.text: The normalized coprojection equation for delta identifies its presheaf isomorphism with the canonical left-adjoint-uniqueness isomorphism. Uniqueness of a left adjoint gives the inverse-image adjunction unit after delta. Substitute b=delta inverse followed by c. The unit and counit equations give the two coefficient equations required for the map/pullback adjunction on ringed modules.

Apply SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardAdj to composition and base change with these coefficient equations. Its left adjoint is restriction followed by scalar transport. Uniqueness against the actual module-pullback adjunction produces the natural isomorphism. Evaluate its unit equation on an original section; naturality along the distinguished index unit reduces the claimed section formula to the map/pullback adjunction triangle identity. This works also for zero rings and empty sites.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleSlice_ordinary_comparison {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.ProEt)
    (O : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U.left) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage U.hom CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj O ≅ B)
    (delta : ProEtaleObjectRestrictionComparison U CommRingCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ i : proEtaleRingModulePullback U.hom O B c ≅
        proEtaleSliceModuleRestriction U O ⋙
          ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.e U O B c delta,
      ∀ (N : proEtaleRingModules X O) (V : U.left.ProEt)
        (m : N.val.obj
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (f := U.hom) ⊤ U.prop).obj V))),
        (i.hom.app N).val.app (op V)
          (proEtaleSlicePullbackSection U O B c N V m) = m
